title: TurnOver plugin manifest
description: Who made the plugin and which applications it is for (PLUGIN-GUIDE.md).

id.description: One word: letters, digits and hyphens. The same id replaces.

apps.description: Bundle identifiers; nothing applies anywhere else.

formatVersion.description: 1 for rules only; 2 when the plugin has a script.

summary.description: One line, spoken at install and in the library.

contact.description: An email address or web page for problems.

changes.description: What changed in each version, newest first.

abilities.description: What it asks to do, in TurnOver's fixed words. A script needs at least one; edit and clipboard are for scripts.

privacy.description: What it reads and where anything goes.

license.description: An open licence (SPDX name); the library's own is MIT.

script.description: The plugin's script, always main.js, next to manifest.json (at most 256 KB, UTF-8). Needs formatVersion 2, abilities, and apps named exactly (no patterns). It runs in a sandbox and only after the person has approved it.

commands.description: The commands the script handles (turnover.command(id, handler)). Needs script. Keys and letters follow the rules for a key in profile.json.

id.description: Letters and digits only; the name the script uses.

description.description: What the command does, for input help.

key.description: A TurnOver gesture, as a key in profile.json is written.

letter.description: Its letter in the plugin layer.
